blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Undersampled magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) reconstruction aims to recover high-quality images from partially acquired k-space data, thereby reducing scan time. However, missing frequency-domain measurements often lead to residual aliasing artifacts, blurred edges, and loss of local structural details. In this paper, we propose AGGR-Mamba, a lightweight output-stage residual refinement method built upon a Mamba backbone for undersampled brain MRI reconstruction. The Mamba backbone first produces an initial reconstruction, and the proposed refinement modules then correct the remaining local errors and high-frequency artifacts in a controlled residual manner. Specifically, an Attention Refine Head is introduced to recalibrate local anatomical structures, edge textures, and residual-error regions through channel and spatial attention. In addition, a GDFN-style gated residual refinement branch is designed to selectively preserve informative residual features while suppressing redundant or unstable responses. By combining attention-based recalibration with gated residual selection, AGGR-Mamba improves local structure recovery without substantially disturbing the backbone reconstruction. Experiments are conducted on the IXI brain MRI dataset with T1- and T2-weighted images under acceleration factors of R=4 and R=8. The results show that AGGR-Mamba achieves competitive PSNR and SSIM performance across different reconstruction settings, demonstrating the effectiveness of the proposed output-stage refinement strategy.
blocks.zh: 被取样的磁共振成像(MRI)重建旨在从部分获得的k空间数据中恢复高质量的图像,从而缩短扫描时间. 然而,缺失的频域测量往往导致残存的异名文物,边缘模糊,局部结构细节丢失. 在本文中,我们提出AGGR-Mamba,这是一种轻量级输出级剩余精炼方法,其基础是Mamba骨干,用于对大脑核磁共振进行检测不足。 Mamba主干线首先产生初步重建,拟议的改进模块然后以可控的残余方式纠正剩余的局部错误和高频文物. 具体来说,引入了一个Reflect Reflectine Head,通过信道和空间关注来重新校正局部解剖结构,边缘纹理,以及残留-error区域. 此外,一个GDFN风格的门式残余精炼分支旨在有选择地保留信息丰富的残余特征,同时压制多余或不稳定的反应. AGGR-Mamba将基于注意力的重新调整与有门的剩余选择相结合,改善当地结构的恢复,同时不严重干扰骨干重建。 在加速因子R=4和R=8下,用T1-和T2-加权图像在九一脑磁共振数据集上进行实验. 结果显示,AGGR-Mamba公司在不同重建环境中取得了具有竞争力的PSNR和SSIM业绩,显示出拟议产出阶段完善战略的有效性。

blocks.en: I INTRODUCTION
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en: Magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) is an important medical imaging technique that provides high soft-tissue contrast, rich structural information, and no exposure to ionizing radiation. Owing to these advantages, it has been widely used in the analysis of brain disorders, clinical diagnosis, and medical research [ 1 ] . However, MRI data acquisition is typically time-consuming. Long acquisition times can compromise clinical workflow efficiency, increase patient discomfort, and introduce motion-related artifacts caused by patient movement, which may adversely affect subsequent diagnosis and image analysis [ 2 ] . To improve MRI acquisition efficiency, a commonly used strategy is to undersample the data in k-space. By acquiring fewer k-space measurements, undersampling can reduce scan time, but the resulting lack of complete frequency-domain information makes reconstructed images susceptible to aliasing artifacts, loss of textural details, and blurred edges [ 3 ] .
blocks.zh: 磁共振成像(MRI)是一种重要的医学成像技术,可以提供高软质对比,丰富的结构信息,不暴露于电离辐射. 由于这些优势,它被广泛用于脑病分析,临床诊断,医学研究[1]. 然而,核磁共振数据的获取通常很费时。 长时间的获取时间会损害临床工作流程的效率,增加病人的不适,并引入由病人运动引起的运动相关文物,这可能会对以后的诊断和图像分析产生不利影响[2]. 为了提高核磁共振的获取效率,一个常用的战略是用k-空间对数据进行不足抽样。 通过获得较少的k-空间测量,下取样可以减少扫描时间,但由此导致的全频域信息缺乏,使得重建的图像容易被别名文物,纹理细节丢失,边缘模糊[3].

blocks.en: Although conventional compressed sensing MRI methods are supported by a solid theoretical foundation [ 4 , 5 ] , they typically rely on manually designed regularization terms and require the tuning of multiple hyperparameters [ 6 ] , while also suffering from relatively low computational efficiency [ 7 ] . Driven by advances in deep learning [ 8 , 9 ] , CNN-based approaches have been widely explored for learning the reconstruction mapping between undersampled and fully sampled MR images [ 10 ] . CNN-based methods are well suited for local feature extraction, enabling effective recovery of edges and textural details. However, their reliance on local convolutional operations limits their capacity to capture long-range dependencies and global anatomical structures. GAN-based approaches were later explored to enhance the perceptual quality of reconstructed images [ 11 , 12 ] , but the adversarial learning process may introduce training instability and produce anatomically implausible structures.
blocks.zh: 虽然常规的压缩感应磁共振方法得到了坚实的理论基础[4,5]的支持,但它们通常依赖于人工设计的规范化术语,需要调制多个超参数[6],同时也受到相对较低的计算效率[7]. 在深入学习的进展[8,9]的推动下,以CNN为基础的方法被广泛探索,以学习在MR图像被抽样不足和完全抽样之间的重建绘图[10]. 基于CNN的方法非常适合本地特征提取,从而能够有效恢复边缘和纹理细节. 然而,他们依靠当地革命性操作,限制了他们捕捉长距离依赖和全球解剖结构的能力. 后来探索了基于GAN的方法,以提高重建图像的知觉质量[11,12],但对抗性的学习过程可能会引入培训不稳定性,产生解剖学上不合理的结构.

blocks.en: To better capture global contextual dependencies, Transformer-based approaches have been explored for MRI reconstruction [ 13 ] . These methods exploit self-attention to capture long-range dependencies, thereby partially compensating for the inherent limitation of CNNs in global context modeling. However, the self-attention mechanism in Transformers incurs high computational complexity, often resulting in substantial memory footprint and computational burden in high-resolution medical image reconstruction [ 14 ] . In recent years, state space models (SSMs), exemplified by Mamba [ 15 ] , have introduced a new paradigm for long-sequence modeling. Compared with conventional Transformers, Mamba is capable of modeling long-range dependencies at significantly lower complexity and has been progressively integrated into medical image reconstruction tasks.
blocks.zh: 为了更好地抓住全球背景的依赖性,为核磁共振重建探索了基于变换器的方法[13]。 这些方法利用自我意识来捕捉长距离的依赖性,从而部分地补偿了CNN在全球模型制作中固有的局限性. 然而,"变形金刚"中的自我留念机制在计算上产生了很高的复杂性,在高分辨率医疗图像重建中经常导致大量的记忆足迹和计算负担[14]. 近年来,以曼巴[15]为例的状态空间模型(SSMs)引入了长序建模的新范式. 与传统变形器相比,曼巴能够以明显低的复杂程度模拟远距离依赖性,并逐渐融入医疗图像重建任务.

blocks.en: Despite the strengths of Mamba-type reconstruction frameworks in global structural modeling and computational efficiency [ 16 , 17 ] , the restoration of local details and edge-structure preservation at the output stage in undersampled MRI reconstruction can still be further improved. On the one hand, the reconstructed images may still retain local residual artifacts and high-frequency errors. On the other hand, fine anatomical edges, texture transition regions, and low-contrast structures are susceptible to blurring or insufficient detail during reconstruction. Moreover, a conventional output Refine Head typically applies a relatively uniform correction across the entire image and struggles to distinguish valid structural details from residual errors and spurious high-frequency noise, which may compromise the stability of the refinement process.
blocks.zh: 尽管Mamba型重建框架在全球结构模型和计算效率[16,17]方面有优势,但在被取样的核磁共振重建的产出阶段恢复局部细节和边缘结构保存的工作仍可进一步改进。 一方面,重建的图像可能仍然保留局部残余文物和高频误差. 另一方面,精细的解剖边缘,纹理过渡区域,低混凝土结构在重建期间容易模糊或不够详细. 此外,一个常规输出Fine Head一般对整个图像进行相对统一的校正,并努力区分有效的结构细节与剩余错误和虚假的高频噪音,这可能会损害完善过程的稳定性.

blocks.en: To address these limitations, this paper proposes AGGR-Mamba, an output-stage attention-guided and gated residual refinement method for undersampled MRI reconstruction. The proposed method uses a Mamba backbone to obtain an initial reconstruction and attaches a lightweight refinement branch at the output stage. This branch is designed to compensate for local reconstruction errors, edge blurring, and residual high-frequency artifacts that may remain after the backbone reconstruction. The refinement process combines attention-guided local detail recalibration with gated residual feature selection, allowing the network to enhance informative anatomical structures while suppressing unstable residual responses.
blocks.zh: 为解决这些局限性,本文件建议采用AGGR-Mamba,这是为未加取样的磁共振重建提供输出阶段的注意制导和锁定的剩余改进方法。 拟议方法使用曼巴骨干,以获得初步重建,并在输出阶段附设轻量级精密分支. 本分支旨在补偿局部重建失误,边缘模糊,以及骨干重建后可能留下的残余高频文物. 完善过程结合了以注意力引导的局部细节重新校正和有门的残余特征选择,使网络能够加强信息解剖结构,同时抑制不稳定的残余反应.

blocks.en: The major contributions of this study are as follows:
blocks.zh: 这项研究的主要贡献如下:

blocks.en: • A lightweight output-stage residual refinement design. We introduce a lightweight residual refinement branch after the Mamba backbone. Instead of modifying the main reconstruction process, the proposed design refines the backbone output by compensating for local errors and residual artifacts, leading to improved local structural representation in the reconstructed image. • An attention-guided local detail recalibration mechanism. The proposed Attention Refine Head uses channel and spatial attention to adaptively recalibrate channel and spatial responses associated with local structures and residual-error regions. This design reduces uniform correction over the entire image and makes the refinement process more focused on structurally informative areas. • A gated residual feature selection strategy. Since residual features may contain useful high-frequency details as well as noise and unstable responses, we introduce a GDFN-style gated branch to selectively filter candidate residual features. This mechanism enhances reconstruction-relevant details while suppressing ineffective high-frequency noise and residual artifacts.
blocks.zh: • 支助 轻量级输出级剩余完善设计. 在曼巴骨干之后,我们引入了轻量级剩余精炼分支. 拟议的设计没有修改主要重建过程,而是通过补偿当地的错误和剩余文物来完善骨干产出,从而改进重建图像中的当地结构代表性。 注意指导的地方细节调整机制。 拟议的 " 注意力优化 " 利用信道和空间注意力来适应性地调整信道和空间反应,与地方结构和残留-敏感区域有关。 这种设计减少了对整个图像的统一校正,使改进过程更加侧重于结构信息领域。 一项封闭式剩余特性选择战略。 由于残留特征可能包含有用的高频细节以及噪音和不稳定的响应,我们引入了GDFN式的门形分支,有选择地过滤候选残留特征. 这一机制加强了与重建有关的细节,同时抑制了无效的高频噪音和残余文物。

Instead of modifying the main reconstruction process, the proposed design refines the backbone output by compensating for local errors and residual artifacts, leading to improved local structural representation in the reconstructed image.

blocks.en: II Related Work
blocks.zh: 二. 相关工作

blocks.en: II-A CNN-based MRI Reconstruction
blocks.zh: 基于CNN的磁共振磁共振 重建

blocks.en: CNN-based MRI reconstruction methods generally learn a nonlinear mapping from undersampled images to their fully sampled counterparts. Representative architectures include U-Net, deep residual networks, and cascaded convolutional networks [ 18 , 19 ] . These methods are effective at extracting local features and can recover edges, textures, and fine structural details. However, because convolutional operations mainly rely on local receptive fields, CNN-based models may struggle to restore subtle details and delineate structural boundaries clearly, especially in complex brain anatomy and highly accelerated undersampling scenarios.
blocks.zh: 基于CNN的核磁共振重建方法一般会从被取样不足的图像中学习到非线性映射到其完全被取样的对应物. 代表性架构包括U-Net,深层残余网络,以及级联演化网络[18,19]. 这些方法在提取局部特征时是有效的,可以回收边缘,纹理,以及细细的结构细节. 然而,由于进化操作主要依赖于本地的可接受领域,基于CNN的模型可能会努力恢复微妙的细节,并明确划定结构界限,特别是在复杂的脑解剖学和高度加速的底样图案中.

blocks.en: II-B Physics-guided MRI Reconstruction
blocks.zh: II-B 物理导磁共振 重建

blocks.en: Physics-guided MRI reconstruction methods embed the imaging model of MRI into deep reconstruction networks [ 20 ] . These methods commonly rely on a data consistency module to keep the reconstructed result consistent with the sampled k-space data. By combining physical constraints with the representational capacity of deep networks, these methods tend to provide more stable performance in undersampled MRI reconstruction. Models such as E2E-VarNet [ 21 ] fall into this category. The Mamba backbone used in this study follows the same principle of physics-guided reconstruction, where the backbone reconstruction module and data consistency constraint jointly contribute to improved reconstruction quality.
blocks.zh: 物理导磁共振重建方法将磁共振成像模型嵌入深层重建网络[20]. 这些方法通常依靠一个数据一致性模块来保持重建后的结果与所抽样的k-空间数据保持一致. 这些方法将物理限制与深层网络的代表能力结合起来,往往在被取样的核磁共振重建中提供更稳定的性能。 E2E-VarNet等模型[21]属于这一类别。 本研究中使用的曼巴骨干遵循同样的物理指导重建原则,骨干重建模块和数据一致性制约共同有助于提高重建质量.

blocks.en: II-C Transformer-based MRI Reconstruction
blocks.zh: II-C 变压器磁共振 重建

blocks.en: Transformer-based methods have also been explored for MRI reconstruction, mainly because self-attention can model long-range dependencies beyond the local receptive field of CNNs. For example, ReconFormer [ 22 ] adopts a recurrent Transformer design with multi-scale attention to improve reconstruction quality. Despite these advantages, the self-attention operation is often costly, and its use in high-resolution image reconstruction can result in heavy GPU memory usage and increased computational burden [ 23 ] .
blocks.zh: 也为核磁共振重建探索了基于变压器的方法,这主要是因为自觉可以模拟超出CNN本地可接受领域的长距离依赖. 例如,ReconFormer [22]采用了反复出现的变形器设计,多尺度关注以提高重建质量. 尽管有这些优势,但自留心操作往往成本高昂,在高分辨率图像重建中使用,可能导致GPU内存使用量大,计算负担增加[23].

blocks.en: II-D Mamba-based MRI Reconstruction
blocks.zh: 基于Mamba的磁共振 重建

blocks.en: Mamba-based methods model long-range dependencies through state space models. Compared with Transformer-based models, their linear-complexity sequence modeling is more efficient for long inputs, which is beneficial for high-resolution medical image reconstruction. In MRI reconstruction, Mamba-based designs are commonly combined with data consistency constraints so that the network can exploit both learned feature representations and the acquired k-space measurements [ 17 ] .
blocks.zh: 基于曼巴的方法通过状态空间模型建立远程依赖性模型. 与基于变形器的模型相比,它们的线性复杂序列模型对长输入效率更高,有利于高分辨率的医疗图像重建. 在核磁共振重建中,基于Mamba的设计通常与数据一致性的限制相结合,以便网络能够同时利用学到的特征表示和获得的k空间测量[17].

blocks.en: Although these methods have shown strong potential in global context modeling and physics-guided reconstruction, most existing designs mainly focus on the main reconstruction stages. The output stage is less explicitly explored, especially for local error compensation, edge-detail preservation, and residual high-frequency artifact suppression. Motivated by this observation, AGGR-Mamba keeps the Mamba backbone as the main reconstruction component and introduces lightweight output-stage refinement modules to improve local structure recovery and refinement stability.
blocks.zh: 虽然这些方法在全球背景建模和物理学引导的重建中显示出了强大的潜力,但大多数现有设计主要侧重于主要重建阶段. 产出阶段的探索不够明确,尤其是针对局部误差补偿,边缘细节保存,剩余高频文物压制. 在这项观察的推动下,AGGR-Mamba公司保留了Mamba骨干作为主要重建部分,并引入了轻量级产出级改进模块,以改善当地结构的恢复和完善稳定性。

blocks.en: III Methodology
blocks.zh: 三、结 论 方法

blocks.en: III-A Mamba Backbone
blocks.zh: III-A 曼巴背骨

blocks.en: AGGR-Mamba adopts a Mamba-based reconstruction network as the backbone [ 17 ] . The backbone is organized as a six-stage unrolled reconstruction network. Each reconstruction stage consists of one VSSLayer followed by one Data Consistency (DC) module, where each VSSLayer contains two VSSBlocks. The VSSBlocks are used to model long-range dependencies and global contextual information, while the DC modules enforce consistency between the intermediate reconstruction and the acquired k-space measurements. Therefore, the backbone contains 12 VSSBlocks and six stage-wise DC modules in total. After the six stages, an additional final DC module is applied for data consistency enforcement. Based on the backbone output, AGGR-Mamba further applies the Attention Refine Head and the GDFN-style gated residual refinement branch to compensate for remaining local errors at the output stage.
blocks.zh: AGGR-Mamba采用基于Mamba的重建网络作为骨干[17]. 骨干组织为六级未滚动重建网. 每个重建阶段包括一个VSSLayer,然后是数据一致性(DC)模块,每个VSSLayer包含两个VSSBlock. VSSBlocks用于建模远程依赖和全球背景信息,而DC模块则强制中间重建与获得的k空间测量之间的一致性. 因此,主干部分总共包含12个VSSBlock和6个阶段性DC模块. 在六个阶段之后,又采用了一个DC最后模块来执行数据一致性。 基于骨干输出,AGGR-Mamba进一步应用了注意力优化头和GDFN风格的闸门余修分支,以补偿输出阶段剩余的局部错误.

blocks.en: The Mamba backbone can produce a relatively stable initial reconstruction, but residual errors may still remain around local edges, texture-transition regions, and low-contrast structures. To further strengthen local structural representation at the output stage, we attach an Attention Refine Head after the backbone output to perform lightweight feature recalibration on the two-channel reconstruction.

blocks.en: The Attention Refine Head provides an initial recalibration of the output features in both channel and spatial dimensions. Through gated feature selection, the branch preserves useful detail residuals while filtering redundant or unstable candidate residual responses, thereby reducing their interference with the final reconstruction.

blocks.en: IV Experimental Setup and Results Analysis
blocks.zh: 四. 实验设置和结果分析

blocks.en: IV-A Dataset
blocks.zh: IV-A 数据集

blocks.en: The effectiveness of the proposed AGGR-Mamba is evaluated on the IXI brain MRI dataset. The IXI dataset was collected as part of the IXI–Information eXtraction from Images project [ 26 ] , and is publicly available at: https://brain-development.org/ixi-dataset/ . The dataset contains multiple MRI sequences from healthy subjects, including T1-weighted, T2-weighted, and PD-weighted images. This study focuses on single-modality undersampled brain MRI reconstruction and compares the proposed method with ReconFormer and other representative baselines. Experiments are conducted on both T1-weighted and T2-weighted modalities, with training and testing performed under the R = 4 R=4 and R = 8 R=8 undersampling settings.
blocks.zh: 在第九十一脑磁共振数据集上对拟议的AGGR-Mamba的有效性进行评估。 第九十一套数据集是作为第九十一套 -- -- 从图像中获取信息[26]项目的一部分收集的,可在https://brain-development.org/ixi-dataset/上公开查阅。 数据集包含来自健康主体的多个核磁共振序列,包括T1加权,T2加权,以及PD加权图像. 本研究侧重于单模式下取样的脑磁共振重建,并将拟议方法与ReconFormer和其他有代表性的基线进行比较. 在T1加权和T2加权两种模式上进行实验,在R=4 R=4和R=8 R=8底取样设置下进行训练和测试。

blocks.en: All experiments in this work are conducted on a server equipped with a single NVIDIA Tesla V100-PCIE-32GB GPU for training and testing. The model is implemented with PyTorch 2.0.1+cu118 and Python 3.8.20. The experiments use the IXI single-coil brain MRI data that have been preprocessed into H5 format. In the processed H5 data used in this work, the T1 setting contains 2950 training slices, 600 validation slices, and 1200 testing slices, while the T2 setting contains 2443 training slices, 512 validation slices, and 1040 testing slices. The four experimental settings, namely IXI-T1 R = 4 R=4 , IXI-T1 R = 8 R=8 , IXI-T2 R = 4 R=4 , and IXI-T2 R = 8 R=8 , are trained and tested independently.
blocks.zh: 这项工作中的所有实验都是在一个配备单NVIDIA Tesla V100-PCIE-32GB GPU的服务器上进行,用于培训和测试. 该模型由PyTorch 2.0.1+cu118和Python 3.8.20实施. 实验使用已预先加工成H5格式的九一单焦脑核磁共振数据. 在这项工作使用的经过处理的H5数据中,T1设置包含2950个训练片,600个验证片,1200个测试片,而T2设置包含2443个训练片,512个验证片,1040个测试片. 四个实验设置,即 IXI-T1 R = 4 R = 4 R , IXI-T1 R = 8 R = 8 R , IXI-T2 R = 4 R = 4 R , 以及 IXI-T2 R = 8 R = 8 ,都是经过独立培训和测试的.

blocks.en: During training, only the training set is used to update the output-stage parameters. The model is evaluated on the validation set every 500 iterations, and the best model weights are saved according to validation PSNR. The final testing metrics are computed on the test set using the corresponding best model weights. The test set is not involved in model selection. The model output is represented by two real/imaginary channels and is converted into a magnitude image before PSNR and SSIM are calculated. The SSIM(%) reported in the tables is defined as SSIM × 100 \mathrm{SSIM}\times 100 .
blocks.zh: 在培训期间,只有培训集用于更新产出阶段参数。 该模型每500次迭代在验证集上评价,最佳模型权重根据验证PSNR保存. 最终的测试指标是使用相应的最佳模型权重在测试组上计算的. 测试集不参与模型选择. 模型输出由两个真/象通道代表,在PSNR和SSIM计算之前转换成星等图像. 表中报告的 SSIM (%) 被定义为 SSIM × 100\ mathrm{ SSIM}\times 100 。

blocks.en: IV-B Implementation Details
blocks.zh: 四-B 执行详情

blocks.en: The model used in the main experiments is AGGR-Mamba. Built on the Mamba backbone, AGGR-Mamba further incorporates an Attention Refine Head and a GDFN-style gated residual refinement branch at the output stage. In the final optimization stage, the trained backbone is frozen and only the Attention Refine Head and GDFN-style branch are updated. These modules refine the backbone reconstruction through local feature recalibration and gated residual compensation.
blocks.zh: 主要实验中使用的模型是AGGR-Mamba. AGGR-Mamba在Mamba主干线上,在产出阶段还增加了一个注意精细头和一个GDFN式的门式剩余精细化分支。 在最终的优化阶段,训练有素的骨干被冷冻,只有注意力强化头和GDFN风格分支更新. 这些单元通过重新调整当地特征和加盖门面的剩余补偿来完善骨干重建。

blocks.en: The comparison methods include UNet [ 10 ] , E2E-VarNet [ 21 ] , SwinUNET [ 27 ] , SwinMR [ 28 ] , and ReconFormer [ 22 ] . Among them, UNet serves as a representative CNN-based reconstruction baseline, E2E-VarNet represents physics-guided unrolled reconstruction methods, SwinUNET and SwinMR are included as Transformer-based reconstruction methods, and ReconFormer represents recurrent Transformer-based MRI reconstruction. By covering CNNs, unrolled networks, Transformers, and recurrent Transformer models, these comparisons provide a more comprehensive evaluation of AGGR-Mamba on undersampled brain MRI reconstruction using the IXI dataset.
blocks.zh: 比较方法包括UNet [10],E2E-VarNet [21],SwinUNET [27],SwinMR [28],以及ReconFormer [22]. 其中,UNet作为CNN代表性的重建基线,E2E-VarNet代表物理制导的无卷式重建方法,SwinUNET和SwinMR作为变形器重建方法被列入其中,ReconFormer代表经常性变形器磁共振重建. 通过覆盖CNN,未滚动网络,变形器,以及反复出现的变形器模型,这些比较为AGGR-曼巴利用九一数据集对脑磁共振重建进行了更全面的评价.

blocks.en: IV-C Quantitative Analysis
blocks.zh: 四-C 定量分析

blocks.en: Table I reports the quantitative comparison of different methods on the IXI-T1 and IXI-T2 modalities under the R = 4 R=4 and R = 8 R=8 undersampling settings. Overall, AGGR-Mamba achieves competitive results across all four testing settings, with particularly stable performance on the T2-weighted reconstruction tasks. For IXI-T2 R = 4 R=4 , AGGR-Mamba reaches 46.99 dB in PSNR, higher than the 46.71 dB achieved by ReconFormer, and ranks first among all methods in terms of PSNR. Its SSIM(%) is 99.45, which is slightly below ReconFormer’s 99.53. For IXI-T2 R = 8 R=8 , AGGR-Mamba again reports the best PSNR, with 38.48 dB versus 38.34 dB for ReconFormer. This result suggests that, for the T2 modality, output-stage attention recalibration and gated residual compensation can effectively refine the initial reconstruction produced by the Mamba backbone.
blocks.zh: 表一汇报了在R=4 R=4和R=8 R=8下采样设置下不同方法的定量比较. 总体而言,AGGR-Mamba公司在所有四个测试环境都取得了竞争结果,在T2加权重建任务上表现特别稳定。 对于XI-T2 R = 4 R = 4,AGGR-Mamba在PSNR中达到46.99 dB,高于ReconFormer实现的46.71 dB,在PSNR中在所有方法中排名第一. 其SSIM(%)为99.45,略低于ReconFormer的99.53。 对于IX-T2 R = 8 R=8,AGGR-Mamba再次报告最好的PSNR,对ReconFormer来说是38.48 dB比38.34 dB。 这一结果表明,就T2模式而言,产出阶段的注意力调整和有门的剩余补偿能够有效地完善曼巴骨干体产生的初步重建。

blocks.en: AGGR-Mamba also maintains a strong performance on the IXI-T1 tasks. Under the IXI-T1 R = 4 R=4 setting, it obtains a PSNR of 41.94 dB and an SSIM(%) of 99.11, which are close to ReconFormer’s 42.36 dB and 99.24. In the IXI-T1 R = 8 R=8 setting, E2E-VarNet achieves the best PSNR, while ReconFormer gives the best SSIM. AGGR-Mamba obtains a PSNR of 35.39 dB, outperforming ReconFormer at 33.87 dB and ranking second among all compared methods. These results suggest that AGGR-Mamba remains stable across different modalities and undersampling rates. Its advantage is more evident in PSNR improvement and residual error correction, although the structural similarity metric in some T1 settings still leaves room for further improvement.
blocks.zh: AGGR-Mamba公司还在第XI-T1号任务方面保持强劲的表现。 在IX-T1 R = 4 R = 4的设置下,它获得41.94 dB的PSNR和99.11的SSIM(%),它们接近ReconFormer的42.36 dB和99.24. 在IXI-T1 R = 8 R = 8 设置中,E2E-VarNet实现了最好的PSNR,而ReconFormer给出了最好的SSIM. AGGR-Mamba获得35.39 dB的PSNR,比33.87 dB的ReconFormer高,在所有比较方法中排名第二. 这些结果表明,GAGR-Mamba在不同的模式和抽样率方面保持稳定。 其优点在PSNR改进和剩余误差校正中更为明显,尽管一些T1环境的结构相似度度量度仍然留有进一步改进的余地.

blocks.en: From the perspective of model types, UNet and SwinUNET generally obtain lower quantitative scores, which suggests that pure CNN reconstruction and directly transferred U-shaped Transformer designs remain limited on the current IXI task. SwinMR improves over UNet and SwinUNET in most cases, but its performance is still behind ReconFormer and AGGR-Mamba. E2E-VarNet performs well on IXI-T1 R = 8 R=8 , reflecting the benefit of physics-guided unrolled networks in enforcing data consistency under certain high-acceleration settings. By comparison, AGGR-Mamba first produces a stable reconstruction through the Mamba backbone and then improves PSNR with output-stage attention recalibration and gated residual compensation. Its SSIM remains second-best or close to the best result in several settings, suggesting that the proposed lightweight refinement design provides useful compensation for local reconstruction errors.
blocks.zh: 从模型型号的角度来看,UNet和SwinUNET普遍获得较低的定量分数,这表明纯CNN重建以及直接转移的U形变形器设计仍然限于目前的九一任务. 斯温 MR在多数情况下优于UNet和SwinUNET,但其性能仍然落后于ReconFormer和AGGR-Mamba. E2E-VarNet在IXI-T1 R = 8 R = 8上表现良好,反映了物理学导引的无滚动网络在某些高加速设置下执行数据一致性的好处. 相比之下,AGGR-Mamba公司首先通过Mamba骨干骨干进行稳定的重建,然后改进PSNR,对产出阶段的注意力进行重新调整,并对剩余补偿加闸。 它的SSIM在几种设置中仍然是次优或接近最佳结果,这表明拟议的轻量级改进设计为当地的重建错误提供了有益的补偿.

blocks.en: IV-D Analysis of Experimental Results
blocks.zh: 实验结果分析

blocks.en: Figure 3 shows the reconstructed images, zoomed-in regions, and error maps of different methods under the IXI-T2 R = 4 R=4 setting. As can be seen, the error maps of UNet, SwinUNET, and SwinMR still contain noticeable bright regions, indicating that residual errors remain around local textures and edges. E2E-VarNet and ReconFormer produce lower errors, and their reconstructed images are closer to the target image in terms of overall structure. By contrast, the error map of AGGR-Mamba is generally darker, and the brain tissue boundaries and texture patterns in the zoomed-in regions are also clearer. Its advantage is mainly reflected in reduced error-map intensity and more stable local structures. This suggests that the output-stage refinement modules further correct the initial reconstruction produced by the Mamba backbone, rather than improving the metrics by substantially changing the global image contrast.
blocks.zh: 图3显示在 IX-T2 R = 4 R = 4 设置下的重构图像,缩放区域,以及不同方法的错误图. 可以看出,UNet,SwinUNET和SwinMR的误差地图仍然包含着明显的明亮区域,表明残留的误差仍然围绕着当地的纹理和边缘. E2E-VarNet和ReconFormer产生较低的错误,其重建的图像在整体结构上更接近目标图像. 相比之下,AGGR-Mamba的误差图一般较暗,放大区域中的脑组织界限和纹理模式也较为清晰. 其优势主要表现为误差图强度降低,局部结构较为稳定. 这表明,产出阶段的改进模块进一步纠正了Mamba主干线产生的初步重建,而不是通过大幅度改变全球形象对比来改进衡量标准。

blocks.en: IV-E Ablation Study Analysis
blocks.zh: IV-E 读取研究分析

blocks.en: To assess the effect of the output-stage refinement modules, we perform ablation experiments on IXI-T2 R = 4 R=4 and further compare the late-stage GDFN fine-tuning strategy with joint fine-tuning. All reported results are evaluated on the same fixed test set, with the best checkpoint selected based on validation PSNR.
blocks.zh: 为了评估输出阶段精细化模块的效果,我们对IXI-T2 R = 4 R = 4进行减速实验,并进一步将晚期GDFN微调策略与联合微调进行比较. 所有报告的结果都在同一套固定测试中进行评价,并根据验证结果选择最佳检查站。

blocks.en: Table II reports the module-wise ablation results under the IXI-T2 R = 4 R=4 setting. The baseline Mamba backbone obtains a PSNR of 46.4907 dB and an SSIM of 99.38%. Adding the Attention Refine Head raises the PSNR to 46.9393 dB, which shows that output-stage attention refinement helps recover local details in the initial reconstruction. When the GDFN-style gated residual branch is further introduced, the PSNR improves to 46.9930 dB, suggesting that the gated residual selection mechanism provides additional compensation for the remaining reconstruction errors. With output-stage joint fine-tuning, the final AGGR-Mamba reaches 46.9945 dB in PSNR and 99.45% in SSIM. The improvement over late-stage GDFN fine-tuning is modest, but the results are more stable overall, indicating that jointly optimizing the Attention Refine Head and the GDFN-style branch benefits the final refinement stage.

blocks.en: V Discussion and Conclusion
blocks.zh: 五. 讨论和结论

blocks.en: AGGR-Mamba refines the output of a trained Mamba reconstruction backbone through channel-spatial attention and GDFN-style gated residual filtering. Final-stage optimization updates only the two refinement modules while keeping the backbone fixed. On the evaluated IXI-T2 settings, the method achieves PSNR values of 46.99 dB at R = 4 R=4 and 38.48 dB at R = 8 R=8 . The IXI-T2 R = 4 R=4 ablation identifies Attention Refine as the main source of improvement, with smaller additional gains from GDFN and joint fine-tuning.
blocks.zh: AGGR-Mamba通过信道空间注意和GDFN式门式残余过滤改进了经过培训的Mamba重建骨干的产出。 最后阶段优化仅更新两个完善模块,同时保持骨干固定. 在评价的IXI-T2设置上,该方法在R=4 R=4时达到46.99 dB,在R=8 R=8时达到38.48 dB. blocks.en: The findings are limited to the evaluated IXI single-coil brain MRI settings. Performance is more favorable on T2 images, and the method does not achieve the highest SSIM in every setting. The small differences between fine-tuning strategies require further validation before drawing conclusions about stability. Future work will investigate realistic multi-coil reconstruction and refinement designs incorporating frequency-domain constraints.
blocks.zh: 调查结果仅限于评估的九一单油脑磁共振环境。 性能在T2图像上更受青睐,该方法并不在每个设定中实现最高的SSIM. 微调战略之间的微小差异需要进一步验证,然后才能得出稳定的结论。 今后的工作将调查实际的多油料重建和完善设计,其中将包含频率领域限制。
